verdict.rationale: Cursor Automations let users define rules that run cloud agents automatically, on cron schedules or on events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks, Linear and more. Documented triggers include PR opened/pushed/merged, push-to-branch, comments and labels, and the /automate skill configures triggers from plain language. Hooks add event-triggered scripts inside the agent loop (preToolUse, afterFileEdit, sessionStart, etc.), and Bugbot auto-reviews on PR updates. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations fire reliably in practice.
